text: Monstrous Ranged Cavalry
Melee Caster Infantry
Spears of Orion

Among the many hunter families sworn to the Lord of the Woods, the Spears of Orion are one of the largest. For thousands of years, they have been the vanguard of Orion's Wild Hunt, and the last line of defence guarding the Oak of Ages each winter.
If Orion has need of them, these warriors will answer without hesitation, whatever blades or sorcery await.
Talsyn Hawks

As Lord of Talsyn, Alarielle's earliest and most steadfast supporter, Arloth backed her ascension to the throne of Ulthuan from the very beginning. Unlike other elves within the Everqueen's army, they never wavered at the thought of fighting fellow elves, for their faith in Alarielle was as unshakeable as their loyalty to their own liege.
This unit's blades have long tasted the blood of the Beastmen, their ancient foes.
Durthu's Wargrove
Durthu has awakened other great Treemen who once fought alongside him in ages past, and they now join the sylvan host as his lieutenants. Such an army has not been seen for centuries.
Old comrades who once fought beside Durthu have risen again within the forests of Ulthuan.
Durthu's Wargrove (Treekin)
Great Stag Knights (Bows)
A cavalry unit of Great Stags ridden by women, skilled at harrying and disrupting enemies with hit-and-run attacks.
Twilight Guard

The Twilight Guard are handmaiden archers chosen by the Sisters of Twilight within the forests of Ulthuan to serve as their personal escort. Some of these handmaidens gained an affinity for beasts under Naestra's tutelage, while others were honed into cold, merciless killers under Arahan's training.
A unit of women both gentle and ruthless, forever carrying out the Sisters of Twilight's will throughout the forests of Ulthuan.
War Druids

Rumour holds that certain warriors within the forests of Ulthuan can transform into beasts. They usually walk the woods in animal guise, and there is little in the forest that escapes their knowledge.
Druids can cast spells in human form when needed, then tear through enemy lines in beast form.
War Druids (Beastform)
Forest Spirit Stalkers

The Treemen of the forest are not only a steadfast bulwark but also merciless hunters, waiting silently for prey to draw near, wielding bows fashioned from branches and arrows blessed by the Everqueen.
Some Treemen of the forest have learned to use ranged attacks, firing magical arrows crafted from branches that can pierce even the sturdiest armour.
Malevolent Forest Spirit Stalkers
Treemen touched by Drycha are beings consumed entirely by hatred, fearing no foe in this world, piercing the bodies of their enemies again and again with specially enchanted arrows.
Treemen born of hatred and resentment, whose arrows burst into flame upon impact, searing away the enemy's armour.
